'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***Heavy clashes are reported as [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] tanks reach the outskirts of [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/heavy-clashes-as-israeli-tanks-reach-gaza-city-outskirts-cut-key-road (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] block the [[Salah al-Din Road]], the main highway in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/30/israeli-tanks-on-outskirts-of-gaza-city-with-key-road-cut (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Israel]] announces that its forces rescued an IDF [[private (rank)|private]] who was taken [[hostage]] by [[Hamas]] during an overnight operation involving its [[intelligence agency]] [[Shin Bet]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-captured-soldier-rescued-from-gaza-during-overnight-operation/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Nova music festival massacre|Re'im music festival massacre]]
***The family of [[Germans|German]]-[[Israelis|Israeli]] [[tattoo artist]] and [[influencer]] [[Killing of Shani Louk|Shani Louk]] confirms that she was killed during the Hamas assault on the [[Re'im]] [[music festival]] on [[October 7 attacks|October 7]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-770787 (''Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/german-israeli-shani-louk-seen-paraded-by-terrorists-in-gaza-confirmed-dead/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] dismisses calls for a [[ceasefire]] in the war with Hamas, stating that Israel will continue its military operations. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/10/31/23/israel-rejects-gaza-ceasefire-as-ground-troops-free-one-hostage (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict]]
***[[Saudi Arabia]] declares a "state of high alert" after four [[Saudi Arabian Army|Saudi troops]] are killed in an attack by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] militants in [[Jazan Province]] near [[Saudi–Yemen barrier|the border]] with [[Yemen]]. Saudi air defences also shoot down a [[ballistic missile]] over its territory that was travelling towards [[Israel]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-10-30/saudi-arabia-clashes-with-yemen-s-houthis-rebels-putting-kingdom-on-high-alert (Bloomberg)]
*Three people are killed and five others injured during two [[shootout]]s between supporters of rival candidates in [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]], amid elections for village leaders. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/three-people-killed-as-southern-philippines-holds-village-leader-vote (AFP via Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 United Auto Workers strike]]
**The [[United Auto Workers]] of the [[Automotive industry in the United States|United States]] reaches a tentative deal with [[General Motors]], bringing an official end to the six-week [[industrial action|strike]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/gm-reaches-tentative-deal-with-uaw-source-says-2023-10-30/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that he will remove [[Gabon]], [[Niger]], [[Uganda]] and the [[Central African Republic]] from the [[African Growth and Opportunity Act]] trade program, because of "gross violations" of [[human rights]] and rampant political [[corruption]], effective January 1, 2024. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/us-end-participation-gabon-niger-uganda-central-african-republic-trade-program-2023-10-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Ybor City shooting]]
**Two people are killed and 16 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in the [[Ybor City]] neighborhood of [[Tampa]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. A 22-year-old man is arrested. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/us/two-killed-18-injured-florida-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]] dismisses a case aiming to disqualify former [[Katanga Province|Katanga]] governor [[Moïse Katumbi]] from the presidential election, asserting that Katumbi solely possesses [[Democratic Republic of the Congo nationality law|Congolese nationality]] despite claims of [[Multiple citizenship|dual citizenship]], which [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|the country]] does not recognize. [https://ewn.co.za/2023/10/30/dr-congo-court-rejects-suit-questioning-opposition-leader-s-nationality (AFP via EWN)]
*[[2023 Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections]]
**[[Filipinos]] elect members of the [[Sangguniang Barangay|village]] and [[Sangguniang Kabataan|youth councils]] after a three-year [[2023 Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections#Postponement|delay]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/three-people-killed-as-southern-philippines-holds-village-leader-vote (AFP via Al Jazeera)]
*[[David Adeang]] is elected as [[President of Nauru]] following a no-confidence vote in [[Russ Kun]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/501301/david-adeang-elected-as-the-new-president-of-nauru (RNZ)]
*[[Germany|German]] [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] politician [[Daniel Halemba]] is arrested for using the [[Nazi salute]] and possessing banned [[Totalitarianism|totalitarian]] symbols. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67261127.amp (BBC News)] [https://theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/30/far-right-german-politician-arrested-after-sieg-heil-salutes-heard (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*In a study published in ''[[Nature Geoscience]]'', researchers suggest that solid [[particulates]] (predominantly [[silicate]]) from the [[Chicxulub crater|Chicxulub asteroid impact]] played a dominant role in the radiative forcing leading to the [[Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event]] ([[impact winter]]), contrary to the widely accepted theory that [[Global_dimming#Causes|sulfur aerosols]] led to the [[mass extinction]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231031-asteroid-dust-caused-15-year-winter-that-killed-dinosaurs-study (AFP via RFI)] [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41561-023-01290-4 (Nature)]
*[[Japan]] suspends the [[pilot experiment]] of its first fully autonomous [[self-driving car]] following a minor [[Traffic collision|collision]]. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/japans-first-fully-autonomous-vehicle-suspended/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 EIHL season]]
**The [[South Yorkshire Police]] opens an investigation into the death of [[Adam Johnson (ice hockey)|Adam Johnson]] after his neck was cut by a skate blade during a game between the [[Nottingham Panthers]] and [[Sheffield Steelers]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/oct/30/police-investigate-uk-ice-hockey-tragedy-amid-tributes-to-adam-johnson (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/adam-johnson-death-police-investigating-skate-blade-cut-hockey/ (CBS News)]
**The [[English Ice Hockey Association]] announces that it will mandate neck guards and protectors beginning in 2024 following Adam Johnson’s death. [https://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/38780913/eiha-making-neck-guards-protectors-mandatory-following-death?platform=amp (ESPN)]
*[[Rubiales affair]]
**[[FIFA]] bars former [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] president [[Luis Rubiales]] from all [[Association football|football]]-related activities for three years due to Rubiales' inappropriate conduct during the [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup final]] in August. [https://apnews.com/article/fifa-luis-rubiales-spain-cd0702883950d066fe1b52e240811384 (AP)]
